name: Archive Viewer
description: Browse archives in Orca's editor tabs: .zip, .jar, .apk, .whl, .epub and other ZIP files, .tar, .gz, .bz2, .xz and .zst, .tar.gz too. A file tree with sizes and dates, a filter, previews of text, images and hex, archives inside archives, old code page names and saving one file. Read-only, offline.

cover.alt: Archive Viewer on a 1,856-file ZIP: the folder tree with sizes, and the selected image's size, method, CRC-32 and dimensions.

screenshots.alt: A jar inside a ZIP opened in place: a trail back to Archive, the jar's 86 files in 16 folders, and its MANIFEST.MF previewed.
A .tar.xz of 1,856 files filtered by .ts: the matches in their folders, and src/app/router.ts opened with line numbers.
hero.png previewed without unpacking, found with the .png filter, under its size, method, CRC-32 and dimensions: 1600 × 640.
Russian file names stored in DOS code page 866 read correctly once CP866 · DOS Cyrillic is picked in the Names menu.
CHANGELOG.md saved on its own with Save… and a Saved notice, below its size, method and CRC-32. Shown in Orca's light theme.
